changelog:
v3.7.4 — 5.1 Audio Fix (Part 2) + Live TV Captions

Critical follow-up to v3.7.3. The 5.1 audio rebuild was routing video through FFmpeg software HEVC at the same time, which dropped to ~20 fps on Fire TV Sticks. Video now stays on hardware while audio goes through FFmpeg — the way it was supposed to.

• MediaTek Fire TV Sticks (mt8695 / mt8696 / mt8167) playing 5.1 surround streams no longer lose video performance during the audio pipeline rebuild
• Closed captions now work on US live TV channels — CEA-608 subtitles embedded in the video feed are finally surfaced as a selectable subtitle track
• Poorly-muxed IPTV streams get a 3× larger PTS search window and now play when they previously gave up
• Stream fetches announce a proper User-Agent so aggressive anti-bot providers stop blocking the default okhttp UA
• New Settings → Advanced toggle "Allow Self-Signed Certificates" for users whose IPTV provider uses a self-signed TLS cert (off by default, requires app restart to apply)
• Constant-bitrate seeking enabled for non-standard containers
